name: What are the benefits of upgrading to a new, high-efficiency toilet?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of upgrading to a new, high-efficiency toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading to a high-efficiency toilet (HET) offers several benefits, primarily reduced water consumption. HETs use 1.28 gallons per flush (GPF) or less, significantly lower than older 3.5 to 5 GPF models, leading to substantial savings on your water bill. They are also designed with improved flushing mechanisms, which can reduce clogs and maintenance issues. Many modern toilets also feature sleek designs, comfort heights, and quieter operation, enhancing your bathroom experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-efficiency toilets save water and lower utility bills. They also offer improved flushing, fewer clogs, and modern designs.
